很多人刚到湾区，最想立刻解决的问题就是“我到底该住哪”。这个问题如果只按城市名来: New arrivals often want an immediate answer to "Where should I live?" City names alone rarely give a precise answer. Start with where you need to go every day, then what you can spend, and finally whether you have a car.
对刚来的人来说，什么叫“住得稳”: What does a workable home mean when you're new?
通勤别太硬，不然每天都会被消耗。: Avoid a punishing commute that drains you every day.
租金别把现金流压得太死。: Don't let rent leave your cash flow too tight.
附近最好能买菜、吃饭、收快递。: Ideally, groceries, meals, and package pickup are available nearby.
如果是第一套房，先给自己留一点调整空间。: For your first place, leave room to adjust.
如果你主要去旧金山，通常优先看旧金山或半岛北段: If most trips are to San Francisco, start with the city or the northern Peninsula
如果你的学校、办公室或主要活动范围在 San Francisco，最稳的通常不是: If your school, office, or main activities are in San Francisco, a place with a straightforward trip into the city is usually more practical than somewhere far away. The city itself suits car-free people who like walking and transit. The northern Peninsula may suit those wanting a calmer, steadier routine.
如果你主要去 South Bay，优先看南湾或半岛中南段: If you mainly travel to the South Bay, start there or in the central and southern Peninsula
如果工作或学校在 San Jose、Sunnyvale、Mountain Vie: If your work or school is around San Jose, Sunnyvale, Mountain View, Santa Clara, or Cupertino, starting your search near the South Bay is usually more practical. Some people are initially drawn to San Francisco, then discover the daily trip south is exhausting and another move costs more.
预算和有没有车，会直接改变你的选区逻辑: Your budget and car access directly change how you choose an area
预算紧但要去 South Bay：可以多看 North San Jose、Mil: On a tight budget with a South Bay commute? Explore North San Jose, Milpitas, and Fremont.
没车：优先看离车站近、买菜方便、晚上回家不折腾的地方。: Without a car: prioritize nearby stations, easy grocery access, and a manageable trip home at night.
有车：一定要把停车、保险、桥费和晚归找位一起算进去。: With a car, include parking, insurance, bridge tolls, and finding a space when returning late.
想先落地：可优先考虑短租、转租、室友房。: For an initial landing place, consider a short-term rental, sublet, or room with roommates.
“离站点不远”最好自己在地图上走一次。很多地方纸面上 10 分钟，实际晚归、下雨: Check “close to the station” yourself on the map. A ten-minute walk on paper can feel very different at night, in the rain, or with luggage.
第一套房不一定要一步到位: Your first home doesn't have to solve everything
第一套房很多时候只是落地房，不一定是你一年后最喜欢的地方。对刚来的人来说，先把通: Your first home may simply be a landing place, not your favorite spot a year later. Getting the commute, budget, and daily routine working matters more than getting everything right immediately.
如果你现在同时在看 8 个城市，不如先把它们缩成 2 到 3 个区域。区域选对了: If you're looking at 8 cities at once, narrow them to 2 or 3 regions first. Choosing the right region makes the later city and housing-type decisions easier.
先按自己的真实条件去筛区域: Filter areas around your actual needs
